title: Cobalt Therapeutics Form 8-K securities purchase agreement
bodyText:
UNITED STATES
FORM 8-K
Item 1.01 Entry into a Material Definitive Agreement.
On June 14, 2026, Cobalt Therapeutics Inc. entered into a securities purchase agreement with institutional investors for a registered direct offering and concurrent private placement. The Company agreed to sell 8,000,000 shares of common stock and warrants to purchase 8,000,000 shares of common stock at a combined purchase price of $1.25 per share and accompanying warrant. The warrants have an exercise price of $1.50 per share and are exercisable six months after issuance.
Item 2.03 Creation of a Direct Financial Obligation or an Obligation under an Off-Balance Sheet Arrangement of a Registrant.
The Company also issued $12,000,000 principal amount of senior secured convertible notes. The notes are convertible into common stock at an initial conversion price of $1.10 per share, subject to adjustment.
Item 3.02 Unregistered Sales of Equity Securities.
The warrants and convertible notes were issued in a private placement exempt from registration under Section 4(a)(2) of the Securities Act.
